title: Probing the limits of forward screening and inverse design of crystal materials
abstract: arXiv:2610.32678v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Crystal materials are designed either by screening known crystals for a target property or by generating new crystals with that property. Both routes are judged against public databases of known crystals, but these databases name the same crystal differently. Several materials announced as new by recent generative and autonomous discovery campaigns have since proved to be known phases or close variants of them. The limits of both routes remain unmeasured. Here we probe them by matching the crystals of 55 databases by structure into one self-extending database of 14.6 million crystals and 131.8 million property values, each traced to its source. Only 4.5% of its crystal-property pairs carry a value. To fill the empty pairs, we developed CGTNet, an equivariant graph transformer with state-of-the-art accuracy on several tasks of two public benchmarks. Trained on each task, it forms a library of property models whose predictions we release

translated_title: 探究晶体材料正向筛选与逆向设计的极限
translated_abstract: 晶体材料的设计要么通过在已知晶体中筛选具有目标性能的材料，要么通过生成具有该性能的新晶体。这两种途径都以已知晶体的公共数据库作为评判标准，但这些数据库对同一晶体的命名方式各不相同。近期多个生成式与自主发现项目所宣称的新材料，事后被证明是已知物相或其近似变体。这两种途径的能力极限至今仍未被测量。本文通过将55个数据库中的晶体按结构匹配，构建了一个可自我扩展的数据库，包含1460万种晶体和1.318亿个性能值，且每个数值均可追溯至其来源。该数据库中仅有4.5%的晶体-性能对含有数值。为填补这些空缺，我们开发了CGTNet——一种等变图变换器，在两个公开基准的若干任务上达到了最先进的精度。针对每个任务训练后，它构成了一个性能模型库，我们已发布其预测结果。
tldr: 该研究将55个晶体数据库按结构匹配整合为包含1460万种晶体和1.318亿性能值的统一数据库，揭示晶体-性能数据仅有4.5%被填充，并开发了高精度等变图变换器CGTNet构建性能模型库来填补数据空缺，以此探究晶体材料正向筛选与逆向设计的能力极限。
en_tdlr: By structurally matching 55 databases into a unified self-extending database of 14.6 million crystals and 131.8 million property values—of which only 4.5% of crystal-property pairs are filled—this work develops CGTNet, a state-of-the-art equivariant graph transformer, as a library of property models to fill the gaps and probe the limits of forward screening and inverse design of crystal materials.
